evidence_short: Claim 'Best Response RECISTv1 is the strongest univariate predictor of PFS in the DAPPER cohort (smallest BH-adjusted p)' holds in 25% of 48 universes. Single changes that flip it: endpoint=OS; post_baseline=exclude.
note: multiverse forks change the claim itself: endpoint PFS->OS and excluding post-baseline covariates (which removes best response); not alternative analyses of the same claim (as B13-v1102)

evidence_short: Post-baseline covariates enter the survival models: Best.Response.RECISTv1 (HR 0.18, p=9e-04), Gr1.Gr2.Toxicities (HR 0.5, p=0.0029) and Gr3.Toxicities (HR 2.1, p=0.0011) are measured during/after treatment, so patients
note: post-baseline best response and toxicities used as baseline Cox covariates (same as v1110/v1111/v1113)
